metaTitle: DIT University Fees for B.Tech 4 Years (2026-30 Batch)
metaDescription: DIT University fees for B.Tech 4 years (2026-30): ₹16,35,200 for CSE and ₹10,05,700 for core branches (All India), plus ₹10,000 admission fee. Vs Quantum.
intro: If you are checking DIT University fees for B.Tech 4 years, start with the official Batch 2026-30 fee PDFs, not older database rows. In the All India category, CSE and the CSE specialisations listed in DIT's CSE fee circular add up to ₹16,35,200 over four years. Core branches such as Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, ECE, Petroleum and Robotics & AI add up to ₹10,05,700. Those figures are the official year-wise academic fees added together. They do not include hostel or the one-time admission charges.

The UK State category is cheaper because DIT's course pages apply a 25% scholarship on tuition for the Uttarakhand/Himalayan quota. This guide also places Quantum University, Roorkee beside DIT. Quantum's official 2026 circular publishes first-year fees only, so this page does not invent a four-year Quantum total.

sections.heading: DIT University fees for B.Tech 4 years (Batch 2026-30)
paragraphs: DIT publishes separate 2026-30 fee PDFs for CSE specialisations, Information Technology, and core School of Engineering branches. The CSE programme page shows the same first-year figures as the CSE specialisations PDF, so the four-year CSE total below is the one to use when someone asks for DIT University fees for B.Tech 4 years in computer science.
Year 3 is higher because a ₹25,000 industrial tour charge is built into that year's official annual fee. The totals at the bottom were added by College Decision from those published annual fees.

table.caption: Year-wise academic fees for B.Tech CSE and the CSE specialisations listed in DIT's CSE fee PDF, Batch 2026-30. Source: dituniversity.edu.in, BTech-CSE-Fee-Structure-2026.pdf (checked 27 November 2026). Four-year totals added by College Decision.

sections.heading: Four-year academic totals by B.Tech group
paragraphs: IT sits between CSE and the core engineering branches. Civil, Mechanical and Petroleum specialisations, Electrical Engineering with Electric Vehicle, and ECE with ICT use the same year-wise fees as the core engineering PDF.

On top of the academic total, DIT charges a ₹10,000 admission fee (non-refundable) and ₹5,000 caution money (refundable) at admission. Hostel is optional: a sharing room is listed at ₹1,59,000 for 10 months (hostel ₹75,000, mess ₹79,500, laundry ₹4,500), plus ₹5,000 refundable hostel security, and transport at ₹22,000. Hostel is not part of the four-year academic totals above.
Merit scholarships, where awarded, apply only on tuition, cannot exceed 100% of tuition, and cannot be combined. Fees may change if government rules change, so confirm the amount on your fee receipt.

table.caption: Four-year academic totals (tuition + academic services + industrial tour) from official year-wise fees, Batch 2026-30. Sources: BTech-CSE-Fee-Structure-2026.pdf, BTech-IT-Fee-Structure-2026.pdf and BTech-Core-Fee-Structure-2026.pdf, dituniversity.edu.in. Totals added by College Decision. Admission fee and hostel are extra.

sections.heading: Quantum University first-year B.Tech fees (2026)
paragraphs: Quantum's official School of Technology circular for 2026 lists first-year fees only. It does not publish year 2 to year 4, so a four-year Quantum total is not shown here.

On that first-year notice, Quantum is cheaper than DIT's official first year. DIT CSE (All India) is ₹3,82,600 in 2026-27; Quantum B.Tech CS is ₹1,54,500 for Uttarakhand domicile students and ₹1,59,500 for students from outside the state.

table.caption: Quantum University, first-year B.Tech fees for 2026, School of Technology circular. Source: quantumuniversity.edu.in/downloads/Fee_Structure/Quantum_School_of_Technology.pdf (checked 27 November 2026). Later years are not printed on this notice.

sections.heading: Placements: what official pages actually say
paragraphs: DIT's School of Computing placements page lists an average salary of ₹8.1 LPA and a highest compensation of ₹58.60 LPA, along with 150+ companies and 860+ offers. The page does not name the batch year for those headline figures, so treat them as the university's published snapshot, not a salary promise for 2026.

Older rows in our database had shown a 2023 DIT average of ₹10 lakh and a highest of ₹28 lakh. Those numbers do not match the current official computing placements page, so this guide no longer uses them.
This page does not have a current official Quantum University placement circular, so no Quantum package is quoted here. Ask Quantum for its latest report if placements are a deciding factor.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Quantum's official fee circular is clear on eligibility: Class 12 with Physics and Mathematics, plus one of Chemistry, Biotechnology, Biology or Computer Science/IT, and English. The minimum is 50% in those three subjects, or 55% for B.Tech (Hons) CSE. Admission preference is given to merit in Q-CARE, JEE Main or a state-level entrance exam.
For DIT, use the university's current admissions pages for tests, cut-offs and scholarships. JEE Main is the usual national route students check, but the offer letter is what counts.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: DIT University is in Dehradun, on Mussoorie-Diversion Road, Village Makkawala, Dehradun, Uttarakhand 248009. Quantum University is at 22 km Milestone, Mandawar, Roorkee–Dehradun Highway (NH-73), Roorkee, Uttarakhand 247667. Both are in Uttarakhand, but they are not in the same city.
If you want to stay in Dehradun, that points toward DIT. If Roorkee works for you, still compare the official fee circulars above and ask Quantum for a recent placement report.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If the question is simply DIT University fees for B.Tech 4 years, the official 2026-30 academic total is ₹16,35,200 for CSE and ₹10,05,700 for core branches in the All India category, or ₹13,77,504 and ₹8,49,726 in the UK State category, plus the ₹10,000 admission fee.
Quantum looks clearly cheaper in the first year on its official 2026 circular, but that notice does not give a four-year figure you can put next to DIT's published totals.

DIT has a documented NIRF Engineering rank of 179 in 2022. Later years should be checked on the current NIRF list, because a 2022 rank is not a 2026 rank. On placements, only DIT's computing page gives official headline packages on this guide, and even those come without a named year.
Do not budget from the older ₹8.99 lakh 'year fee' that had appeared in our DIT records. That figure does not match any annual fee on the official 2026-30 PDFs.

faqs.question: What are DIT University fees for B.Tech 4 years?
faqs.answer: For the official Batch 2026-30 academic fees (tuition, academic services and the industrial tour charge), the four-year total is ₹16,35,200 for CSE and listed CSE specialisations, ₹11,28,900 for IT, and ₹10,05,700 for core engineering branches, in the All India category. UK State category totals are ₹13,77,504, ₹9,53,600 and ₹8,49,726. Add a ₹10,000 admission fee and ₹5,000 refundable caution money at admission. Hostel is extra.

faqs.question: Do DIT University fees for B.Tech 4 years include hostel?
faqs.answer: No. The four-year totals on this page are academic fees only. DIT's 2026-30 PDFs list a sharing hostel at ₹1,59,000 for 10 months, plus ₹5,000 refundable hostel security, and transport at ₹22,000.

faqs.question: Why is the UK State category cheaper at DIT?
faqs.answer: DIT's official course pages describe the Uttarakhand/Himalayan State quota as a 25% scholarship on the tuition fee. Academic services and the industrial tour charge stay the same. Only one scholarship can be used, and it cannot exceed 100% of tuition.

faqs.question: What are Quantum University's B.Tech fees for 4 years?
faqs.answer: Quantum's official 2026 School of Technology circular publishes first-year fees only: for B.Tech CS, ₹1,54,500 (Uttarakhand domicile) and ₹1,59,500 (outside the state). This page does not multiply that figure by four, because later years are not on the circular.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for DIT and Quantum University?
faqs.answer: DIT's School of Computing placements page lists an average salary of ₹8.1 LPA and a highest compensation of ₹58.60 LPA, without naming the batch year. This guide does not quote a Quantum package, because no current official Quantum placement circular is cited here.

faqs.question: Are DIT University and Quantum University in the same city?
faqs.answer: No. DIT University is in Dehradun. Quantum University is in Roorkee. Both are in Uttarakhand.

faqs.question: Which exams do DIT and Quantum University accept?
faqs.answer: Quantum's official fee circular lists merit in Q-CARE, JEE Main or a state-level entrance exam. For DIT, confirm tests and cut-offs on the university's current admissions pages; JEE Main is the usual national exam students check.
